title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
authors_zh: Wanghan Xu, Yuhao Zhou, Yifan Zhou, Qinglong Cao, Shuo Li 等
paper_type_zh: 端到端自主科学研究的环境与 rubric 基准
best_for_zh: 需要评估科研 Agent、实验轨迹或科学产物 Judge 的研究者。
one_line: ResearchClawBench grades end-to-end scientific re-discovery from raw data using hidden-paper, expert-weighted artifacts.
ResearchClawBench 以隐藏目标论文和专家加权产物准则，衡量 AI 的端到端科学复现与发现能力。
why: It evaluates a scientific workflow rather than isolated question answering or code generation.
inclusion_reason: ResearchClawBench evaluates research agents through hidden-paper re-discovery and expert artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Science-agent evaluations often check only whether code runs or a final metric resembles a paper, without testing independent problem formulation, protocols, evidence interpretation, and research artefacts. Providing the target paper also enables answer reproduction and conflates retrieval memory with autonomous research.

ResearchClawBench hides the target paper, supplies related literature and raw data, and uses expert weighted multimodal rubrics to assess rediscovery of the scientific core and experimental process.

科学 Agent 评测往往只检查代码能否运行或最终指标是否接近论文，却不验证其是否独立完成问题定义、实验协议、证据解释和研究产物。若提供目标论文，模型还可能复述答案，难以区分检索记忆和自主研究。

ResearchClawBench 隐藏目标论文，向代理提供相关文献和原始数据，并用专家多模态加权 rubric 评价其重新发现核心结论和实验过程的程度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ResearchClawBench contains 40 tasks across ten scientific domains, each grounded in a real paper hidden during evaluation. Only related literature, data, and execution materials are provided. Experts decompose target figures, experiments, methods, and conclusions into weighted multimodal criteria, while ResearchHarness supports comparison of full agents and native LLMs.
ResearchClawBench 含 40 个来自十个科学领域的任务，每题对应真实论文但评测时隐藏目标，仅提供相关文献、数据和执行材料。专家将目标图表、实验、方法和结论拆成带权多模态准则；项目还提供 ResearchHarness，统一比较完整研究 Agent 与原生 LLM。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select papers: Experts select papers whose scientific core can be re-investigated with available data and code.
  1. Package tasks: The target paper is removed while literature, raw data, environments, and instructions are supplied.
  1. Build rubrics: Experts decompose scientific artefacts into weighted textual, graphical, numerical, and protocol criteria.
  1. Run uniformly: Agents operate under controlled budgets and LLMs use ResearchHarness; environments and budgets must be fixed.

1. 选择论文： 专家选取可由公开数据和代码材料重新研究的论文，并确认核心可复现。
  1. 封装任务： 移除目标论文，提供相关文献、原始数据、环境和研究指令，避免直接泄漏。
  1. 建立 rubric： 领域专家将目标科学制品拆成加权文字、图表、数值和实验协议判据。
  1. 统一运行： Agent 在受控预算下研究，LLM 使用 ResearchHarness；复现须固定环境和预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Among seven autonomous agents and seventeen native LLMs, Claude Code averages only 21.5 and the best ResearchHarness model, Claude-Opus-4.7, scores 20.7. Failures centre on protocol mismatch, evidence–claim mismatch, and missing scientific core. Reliable rediscovery remains distant, although a 40-task average can hide domain and environment differences.
7 个自动研究 Agent 和 17 个原生 LLM 中，最强完整 Agent Claude Code 平均仅 21.5，最强 ResearchHarness 模型 Claude-Opus-4.7 为 20.7；错误主要来自实验协议不匹配、证据与结论不对应和遗漏科学核心。结果显示当前系统距离可靠重新发现仍远，但 40 题均值会掩盖领域环境差异。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier science benchmarks ask paper questions, complete code, or reproduce metrics. ResearchClawBench hides target papers and evaluates complete research artefacts rather than one number; multimodal rubrics inspect protocols, figures, and evidence. It measures end-to-end rediscovery rather than code execution alone.
既有科研基准多要求回答论文问题、补代码或复现实验指标。ResearchClawBench 隐藏目标论文，并把完整科研产物而非单一数值作为对象；多模态 rubric 同时检查协议、图表和证据。它测的是端到端重新发现，而不仅是代码执行。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Forty tasks cannot stably represent ten scientific fields.
  1. Limitation 2: Target-paper references may penalise different but valid methods.
  1. Limitation 3: Real research also includes problem selection, long experiments, and peer review.

1. 局限1： 40 个任务难以稳定代表十个科学领域。
  1. 局限2： 目标论文参照可能惩罚不同但有效的新方法。
  1. 局限3： 真实科研还包括选题、长期实验和同行审查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare environment execution, experiment design, figure reproduction, and evidence interpretation.
  1. Use case 2: When training science judges, separate environment failures from reasoning failures.
  1. Use case 3: Rediscovery scores do not directly represent original discovery or wet-lab capability.

1. 使用场景1： 比较科研 Agent 的环境执行、实验设计、图表复现和证据解释。
  1. 使用场景2： 训练科研 Judge 时区分环境失败和科学推理失败。
  1. 使用场景3： 原创发现或湿实验能力不能由重新发现分数直接代表。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Hide target papers and evaluate rediscovery with expert multimodal rubrics.
  2. Method: Paper selection, leakage-controlled packages, artefact decomposition, and uniform budgets.
  3. Data: Forty tasks in ten fields with literature, raw data, and rubrics.
  4. Evidence: The best agent scores 21.5; failures centre on protocol, evidence, and scientific core.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for research agents; allow equivalent alternative discoveries.

1. 一句话定位： 隐藏目标论文，用专家多模态 rubric 评估科研重新发现。
  2. 方法抓手： 论文筛选、去泄漏任务包、制品分解和统一预算。
  3. 数据抓手： 40 题、10 学科、文献、原始数据和加权 rubric。
  4. 证据锚点： 最佳 Agent 21.5，失败集中在协议、证据和科学核心。
  5. 复用决定： 适合科研 Agent；须接受等价替代发现。
